scope: Offline edit persistence routing for original, reduced-preview, and full-quality offline-cache source modes.

coverage.original: Autosave and mask-set save both call set_sidecar; source is full-resolution ready.
coverage.offlinePreview: A missing-source probe selects the reduced preview; autosave and mask-set save both queue against the original path, and no sidecar write occurs.
coverage.offlineHqCache: A seeded cached JPEG is selected when the original read fails; autosave and mask-set save queue against the original path while full-quality readiness remains true.
coverage.warmCacheDisconnect: Reopening a warm full-quality image while the original probe fails preserves the existing image object and render tier, marks the source missing, and queues the next edit.
coverage.replayAndDiscard: Applying or discarding edits while the original remains unavailable leaves the source unavailable. Successful replay records a true zero-byte availability probe for the same opened path, clears queue-required routing, and a later edit uses set_sidecar.

limitations: The offline HQ cache is seeded by the LIBTEST fixture seam with a tiny synthetic PNG; this verifies source-selection and persistence routing, not full-resolution image quality or native cache generation.
Reconnect availability is simulated by the test seam, not a live mounted drive.
